The '''Hevvrol sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Planets in the sector included [[Glom Tho]], [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]] and [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]].

==History==
The sector was hotly [[Hevvrol Sector Campaign|contested]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
